newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Banks, holdings drive Brussels bourse to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Banks, holdings drive Brussels bourse to new highs.

text.p: Heavy buying of banks and holding companies drove the Brussels bourse to new highs on Monday but dealers said the volume could fade on Tuesday, the last day of the present account.
The Bel-20 index .BFX of 20 blue chips ended up 0.50 percent at a new closing high of 2,279.04 points. Earlier the index set a new life high at 2,280.46 points.

Financial issues were the main focus after Friday's announcement of a major reshuffle among holding companies Gevaert, Almanij and Cobepa and a merger between Belgium's seventh and eighth largest banks, Bacob and Paribas Belgium.
